text: {"thinking":"Separate customers may have run independent training jobs below the threshold. Check sealed schedules, customer records, and intercluster traffic for independence. Sustained load may be batch inference. Compare interconnect traffic, outbound traffic, and live chip readings. Missing logs or late payments may reflect routine recordkeeping problems. Compare escrow, bank records, and independent activity measurements. One training run may have been split across job labels or customers. Test whether the segments share an interconnect and whether their combined GPU-hours exceed 50,000. An unlisted cluster may have hosted training. Compare manufacturer inventory with the operator's list and reconcile grid energy with listed capacity. Start with manufacturer inventory as the independent baseline for the system map.","action":"inventory","args":{}}
